observations.body: The LORD rejects multiplied sacrifices, incense, festivals, and prayer while hands are full of blood, then calls for washing, justice, and willing obedience.
observations.label: Many offerings cannot cover violent hands

observations.body: The passage presents abundant worship, bloodshed, hidden face, washing, justice, willingness, and refusal as the scene's observable response or movement.
observations.label: abundant worship, bloodshed, hidden face, washing, justice, willingness, and refusal

observations.body: The passage places worship and injustice beside abundant worship, bloodshed, hidden face, washing, justice, willingness, and refusal.
observations.label: worship and injustice

payload.posture: Read Isaiah 1:10–20 as evidence about sacrifice, keeping its action, claim, context, and limits distinct.
payload.tension: the problem is not scarcity of ritual but contradiction between worship and conduct
payload.title: Many offerings cannot cover violent hands
